div.p: This case-sensitive code system https://awatson1978.github.io/aerospace-medicine-ig/CodeSystem/gravity-context-cs defines the following codes:

tr.td: Standard Earth gravity at approximately 9.81 m/s²
Near-weightless conditions in orbital free-fall, typically 10⁻³ to 10⁻⁶ g
Lunar surface gravity at approximately 1.62 m/s²
Mars surface gravity at approximately 3.72 m/s²
Partial gravity environment not otherwise specified
Greater than 1g, as experienced during launch, re-entry, or centrifuge
Head-down tilt bed rest used to simulate microgravity effects

description.value: Gravitational environment contexts for observations and procedures
